quotes.text: Return the first new message in the folder, or null if there are none.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The July 2025 documentation patch described firstNewMessage as throwing when no new message exists. At fixed accepted revision 0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, the IDL says null and GetFirstNewMessage initializes a null output, returns NS_OK for no database or no first-new key, and suppresses a failed header lookup. The database firstNew key itself remains nsMsgKey_None for an empty list. Keep the API level and revision explicit. No runtime test was run.
title: The folder first-new header contract is nullable in the fixed accepted source
